subtitles.en: A locust plague and the outpouring of the spirit

descriptions.en: A short prophetic book responding to a devastating locust plague. The plague becomes the figure for a coming *day of the Lord*, and the book closes with an oracle of the spirit being poured out on all flesh — later cited at Pentecost in the book of Acts.
